scientific_scope_status: In the declared donor/product-sulfur model, j retained correct products add diversion rate j*b. Under equivalent harmless donor replacement the eventual correct stage probability is1/[1+w/k+j*b*x/(k*(r+x+h))]. Constant-hazard stages give the product of those conditional probabilities; spent-donor washing does not remove retained-product side reactions. Fully harmless return excursions can still accumulate quadratic event counts. Reversible shielding plus irreversible capping needs the actual transient survival law, not an equilibrium protected fraction. Two-step capture/commitment distinguishes correct and wrong donors only through actual capture or chemical reversal/commitment differences; DNA mismatch or departure alone supplies none. Consumed nitrogen alone does not discharge N1024 whole-product self-inactivation.
